# Devil's Mini OS Launcher — ShellCheck remediation report

**Date:** 2026-10-25  
**Normative spec:** PRD-6.2  
**Input evidence:** `08.log`, generated by ShellCheck 0.11.0 on the Termux device  
**Build archive:** `devils-mini-os-launcher-PRD62-shellcheck-patch-2026-10-25.zip`

## Result

All **21 diagnostics shown in the supplied `08.log`** have been addressed in the source or corrected through narrow, documented ShellCheck directives for intentional cross-file/nameref behavior and literal child-shell fixtures. No project-wide warning suppression or severity downgrade was added.

## Remediation map

| Diagnostic group | Change |
|---|---|
| `SC2178`, `SC2128` in `core/core_config.sh` | Renamed the scalar candidate configuration path to `candidate_path`, separating it from associative-array variables named `candidate`. |
| `SC2034` cross-file state/config globals | Added narrow directives at the assignments that are read by separately sourced project files; clarified the shared state/config contract. |
| `SC2034` nameref snapshots | Documented and narrowly annotated the local associative-array snapshots used indirectly by `_copy_config_assoc`. |
| `SC2016` in `test/lib/harness.sh` | Preserved single-quoted child-shell fixtures and added per-invocation directives because their variables must not expand in the parent shell. |
| `SC2126` grep count pipelines | Replaced `grep | wc -l | tr` counting patterns with `awk` line counts or `grep -cF`, preserving zero-match behavior. |
| `SC2034` in `test/test_report_generator.sh` and `test/test_update_all.sh` | Removed unused suite timestamp and retry-path variables. |
| `SC2016` in `test/test_report_generator.sh` | Changed the literal generator line to a `%s` `printf` format so the Markdown backticks are data, not a format string. |

## Verification evidence

- `bash -n`: **51/51** project `.sh` files passed.
- PRD script-length gate: **0 violations**; maximum file length is **499 lines**.
- Mandatory suite: **19/19** test files passed; **918/918** assertions passed.
- Source manifest: **135 entries** verified before and after the suite.
- Repacked ZIP: archive integrity passed; one expected root directory; **0 unsafe archive paths**; manifest verified after fresh extraction.
- Master runner: `bash -n prd62-master-test.sh` passed.

## Device confirmation

Run the master script on Termux to execute ShellCheck 0.11.0 against the exact patched archive. Its report will include the ShellCheck exit status and the full diagnostic log. A clean ShellCheck result is confirmed only when that run reports no diagnostics and exits zero.

```bash
bash "$HOME/storage/downloads/prd62-master-test.sh"
```

The source files and tests were modified; the installed launcher was not changed. The test runner remains read-only with respect to the active installation.
